source.title: Send Me On Me Way!
source.description:
<You hear the disembodied voice of Orthas in your mind>

'Ere we are then. Let's get on with it, shall we?
source.objective: Observe Orthas as he moves on from this world.
source.completion:
You have no words for what just happened. What have you done?

Hopefully there's at least some good loot in this chest.
